config_dir.description: Directory holding the current saved config of each device, as <Category>/<Device>.txt; required: false, type: string, default: resources/configs/

dated_config_dir.description: Directory holding dated config snapshots used by the Configs and Diffs tabs; required: false, type: string, default: resources/configs/dated/

poll_interval_seconds.description: How often each switch is polled over SNMP, in seconds; required: false, type: int, default: 300

poll_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for a switch to answer an SNMP poll, in seconds; required: false, type: int, default: 10

poll_concurrency.description: How many switches are polled at the same time; required: false, type: int, default: 10

prune_interval_hours.description: How often old device sightings are pruned, in hours; required: false, type: int, default: 24

node_retention_days.description: How long device sightings on ports are kept before being pruned, in days; required: false, type: int, default: 90

node_max_per_mac.description: The most sightings kept per MAC address; required: false, type: int, default: 10

arp_poll_interval_seconds.description: How often routers' ARP tables are polled to learn each node's IP address, in seconds; required: false, type: int, default: 300

dns_concurrency.description: How many reverse-DNS lookups (node hostnames) run at the same time; required: false, type: int, default: 20

dns_lookup_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for each reverse-DNS lookup before giving up, in seconds; required: false, type: int, default: 3

dns_domain_suffix.description: Domain suffix removed from resolved hostnames, so host1.example.com shows as host1; empty leaves hostnames as returned; required: false, type: string, default: (empty)

unused_after_days.description: A port with no activity for this many days is listed on the Unused page, in days; required: false, type: int, default: 60
